full_chain.stage: actual interaction denial and side effects
full_chain.observation: WrapOperation around Entity.interact within PlayerEntity.interact first resets shared zero-priority cache PASS and snapshots held item. Iterates actor PreventEntityUsePower first, then target PreventBeingUsedPower, returning first applying executeAction. Conditions use hand/item and pair(actor,target) in both cases, despite power being owned by different entity. executeAction requests optional bientity callback, then performActorItemStuff, then returns configured FAIL. No side guard in these shown methods and no prevention packet send in this wrapper; native client/server invocation frequency unproved.

performActorItemStuff obtains actual actor hand slot StackReference, applies held callback, optionally sets held slot directly to itemResult, creates another resultingStack reference from current held or itemResult.copy, applies resultItemAction to heldStack (not resultingStack), then puts/offers resultingStack when modified. Configured item result can therefore involve both direct replacement and offer/drop branch. Return value from StackReference.set ignored. No inventory payment/rollback or two-sided consistency guarantee. InventoryUtil/native inventory internals and concrete callbacks not expanded, so no runtime duplication claim.

Before wrapper also evaluates nonnegative ActiveInteraction powers by priority, with priority0 cached and original entity call still attempted; after hook consumes cache or tries negative powers only when original PASS. End selects original only if it is accepted while new is not, or should swing while new does not; otherwise returns new. If original is nonaccepted/nonswinging FAIL, cache PASS, no after branch runs, new stays PASS and expression chooses new. This can erase a refusal at the return layer if the native method reaches this injected return slice. Complete before/after methods read, but native PlayerEntity.interact control flow, ActionResult implementation and MixinExtras shared-local initialization on other paths are not read: do not assert observed bypass, offhand retry or side-effect duplication.

PreventedEntityInteractionC2SPacket encodes hand ordinal then runtime entityID and decoder directly indexes Hand.values. ModPackets old constant aliases this packet type. Apoli.onInitialize→ModPacketsC2S.register installs onPreventedEntityInteraction, whose body is empty in this exact commit. Whole cached source search for class, packet path and PREVENTED_ENTITY_USE finds only definition/codec/registration/alias, no actual gameplay sender. No resolution, state recheck, action replay, reply or expiry work is performed by that handler. External mods could send this public packet, but the local empty handler still supplies no full requested receipt lifecycle.
